in_marathi.name: Devatha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devatha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devi, the goddess, is the divine feminine force in Hinduism. Devatha is a variation of this name, meaning 'goddess' or 'divine being'.

in_bengali.name: Devatha
in_bengali.long_meaning: Devatha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Devi, the goddess, is the divine feminine force in Hinduism. Devatha is a variation of this name, meaning 'goddess' or 'divine being'.
